benthic_geometry_repairs_for_analysis_on.note: Invalid source polygons are preserved unchanged in source records. make_valid() is used only for overlay calculations; repaired geometries are not substituted into the source GeoJSON.

purpose: Research-only ecological subregion and mapped benthic habitat candidate audit. No production model inputs.

subregions.name: North Biscayne Bay
subregions.boundary_note: North Biscayne Bay extends from Dumfoundling Bay to the Rickenbacker Causeway in the published ecological segmentation.
subregions.boundary_scope_note: North Biscayne Bay extends from Dumfoundling Bay to the Rickenbacker Causeway in the published ecological segmentation. The cited paper provides landmark limits, not digitized cross-bay boundary lines. No polygon is fabricated; landmark geometry and boundary placement remain pending GIS validation.

provenance.title: Characterizing Nearshore Fish Assemblages From Intact and Altered Mangrove Shorelines in Biscayne Bay, Florida, United States

source_footprints.meaning: Source-map coverage only; not a bay or ecological boundary.

guardrails: North/Central/South are literature-defined ecological contexts, not statutory or management regions.
Their landmark limits are not yet digitized into cross-bay lines or polygons.
NOAA ENC named-water polygons remain source chart context, not complete ecological boundaries.
FWC/NPS benthic overlays are source mapping evidence, not current species-suitability scores.
No channel, inlet, tidal connection, or fish passage is inferred from polygon proximity.
All outputs are research-only; no species files, prediction weights, thresholds, or production APIs are modified.
